component.name: PageLiner
component.summary: EPUB and PDF reader and document library

description.p: PageLiner keeps a library of EPUB and PDF books, remembers where you are in each, and stores bookmarks and highlights. The library and reading state can be synced through git.

ul.li: A cover grid with filters and sorting
A PDF reader with contents, search, text selection and highlights
An EPUB reader with reading themes, serif or sans text, bookmarks and highlights
Optional git sync of the library and reading state
